title: ai settings / Customization marketplace settings
content:
## Customization marketplace settings | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(chat.customizations.marketplace.enabled)` _(Preview)_
Show the unified [**Browse** page](/docs/agent-customization/overview.md#discover-and-install-existing-customizations-preview) when a marketplace source is available. When disabled, discovery remains in the existing customization management pages. | `true` | | `setting(chat.customizations.copilotConnectors.enabled)` `feature(copilot-connectors)`
Control [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} connectors](/docs/agent-customization/copilot-connectors.md) in the unified marketplace and the availability of connected connector MCP servers in {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} agent sessions. | `true` | Organization policy forces both settings off when **Editor preview features** is disabled. See [organization and enterprise settings](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#use-github-organization-and-enterprise-settings).
